## Spawning Sub-Agents

Use the Agent tool with the matching `subagent_type`. Pass problem description, constraints, existing content (when refining), feedback, `multitest`, `interactive`, and tell the sub-agent to follow `.claude/shared.md`.

| Task | subagent_type |
|---|---|
| Generate or refine statement / tutorial | `statement-agent` |
| Generate or refine validator | `validator-agent` |
| Recommend or generate checker | `checker-agent` |
| Suggest approach or generate solution | `solutions-agent` |
| Generate generator or stress script | `generator-agent` |
| Generate interactor (interactive only) | `interactor-agent` |
| Review component or full problem | `reviewer-agent` |

Follow the **Pipeline** in `.claude/shared.md`. Write each file as soon as it is generated. On FAIL or `verify.sh` failure, regenerate only that component (`/fix-component`).

Decide `multitest` and `interactive` once (see shared.md) and pass them to every sub-agent.
